From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@elevation.health>, Lucy Park <lucy.park@elevation.health>, procurement@elevation.health
Date: 2028-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Activation ownership & rollout play — Elevation Health

Team — quick handoff to CS/Implementation for Elevation Health (signed MSA + PO inbound). Key context below and a few asks at the bottom. IUD: RDW-2028-045-ELEV.

Deal snapshot
- ACV: $420k (12-month committed dedicated capacity + support)
- Target go-live: production traffic by 2028-09-15 (requested by customer)
- Primary use: clinical-notes summarization + clinical search embeddings for provider portal

Key external contacts
- Samir Khan (Head of Engineering) — samir.khan@elevation.health (primary tech lead)
- Lucy Park (Director, Product) — lucy.park@elevation.health (POC for acceptance criteria)
- Procurement: procurement@elevation.health (PO routing)

Technical / security constraints called out by customer
- Must support VPC peering and customer-managed KMS for keys (private deployment preferred post-PoC)
- SOC2 report requested during onboarding (attached questionnaire)
- Expected peak concurrent requests: ~75 TPS for embedding writes during nightly sync; steady-state generation bursts ~20 RPS

What we (sales) will do: finalize SOW via DocuSign once CS confirms kickoff date and owners. PO (ref PO_Elevation_00057.pdf) is attached as confirmation of spend.

Asks for CS/Implementation team
1) Please confirm primary CS owner + Implementation lead for this engagement.
2) Recommend initial kickoff window (2-hour technical + success alignment) between 2028-06-20 and 2028-06-24.
3) Any immediate blockers on security evidence or technical prerequisites? I attached: Elevation_SOW_v1.pdf, Kickoff_Agenda_v2.docx, Security_Questionnaire_Elevation.xlsx.

Notes: customer is sensitive to data residency; they requested US-only regions for production. They'd like a canary rollout and a rollback plan at sign-off.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirm so we can route SOW/DocuSign.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments (stubs): Elevation_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF), Kickoff_Agenda_v2.docx, Security_Questionnaire_Elevation.xlsx

Subject: Re: Activation ownership & rollout play — Elevation Health

Aditya — thanks for the clear handoff. Quick confirmation below and a few clarifying questions so Implementation can scope the kickoff properly.

Owner assignments (proposed)
- Primary CS Owner: Grace O'Connor (me) — overall success/acceptance, exec reporting, adoption metrics
- Implementation Lead: Marissa Cole — project plan, sprints, acceptance gates, runbooks
- Infra/escalation lead: Vivek Kulkarni — VPC/KMS, performance SLOs, canary strategy

Proposed kickoff windows
- 2028-06-21 10:00–12:00 PT (preferred)
- 2028-06-22 09:00–11:00 PT

Clarifying Qs (Samir / Lucy, feel free to reply inline)
1) Data flows: will Elevation push PHI into our hosted environment during POC, or will they keep data on-prem until private deployment is ready? This affects access controls and logging scope.
2) KMS: customer asked for customer-managed keys — can procurement provide a preliminary KMS ARN or do they need help generating one?
3) Acceptance criteria: Lucy, can you share the top 3 success metrics you want measured at go-live (e.g., latency P95, summary accuracy threshold, search recall)?

Immediate internal actions once owners confirmed
- Marissa to build a 6-week implementation sprint plan and share by 2028-06-14.
- Vivek to run quick capacity check for 75 TPS embedding bursts and reply with suggested Dedicated pool configuration by 2028-06-13.
- I will schedule the customer kickoff for the confirmed window and prep an executive one-pager.

Marissa / Vivek — can you reply with availability and any initial red flags?

Thanks — GRACE
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0299

Date: 2028-06-11T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation ownership & rollout play — Elevation Health

Grace / Aditya — thanks for the handoff and proposed owners. Quick replies inline: 

- Kickoff window: 2028-06-21 10:00–12:00 PT works for our team. Please confirm a calendar invite with dial-in + shared Drive folder.
- Data flows: for POC we will push de-identified clinical notes into your hosted sandbox (US region). No PHI in hosted environment during POC; full-production will move to private deployment and customer-managed KMS.
- KMS: procurement will provide the KMS ARN during the first week of July; for kickoff please proceed with a sandbox-managed key.
- Acceptance metrics (Lucy): Lucy asked for the following top-line targets — 1) summary latency P95 < 750ms; 2) clinical-summary F1 >= 0.78 on provided test-set; 3) embedding recall@10 >= 0.85 for search queries.
- Procurement: PO_Elevation_00057.pdf attached. We will follow up with a signed SOW via DocuSign; expect DocuSign link by EOD 2028-06-12.

Technical contact for onboarding: Jae Kim <jae.kim@elevation.health> (platform lead) — please add to invites.

Open risks we want you to note:
1) Internal IAM provisioning for their vendor accounts must be completed before canary (their security team is strict).
2) We intend to run load tests during week 3 of the plan; please ensure we have a rollback plan if latency or error rates spike.

We look forward to the kickoff. Samir

Attachments (stubs): PO_Elevation_00057.pdf

Grace / Aditya — internal note with action items after Samir's replies. Please treat this thread as our working doc.

Action items and owners (internal)
- Marissa: Draft 6-week sprint plan (sprint0: sandbox onboarding; sprint1: data ingestion + embedding pipeline; sprint2: canary rollout) — deliver by 2028-06-18. Attachment: Kickoff_Agenda_v2.docx (updated outline).
- Vivek: Capacity plan for Dedicated pool (estimate: 4x A100 equivalence with burst autoscale) + rollback playbook for canary — deliver by 2028-06-13.
- Grace: Send calendar invite for confirmed kickoff (2028-06-21 10:00–12:00 PT) and upload CS one-pager to shared Drive.
- Aditya: Monitor DocuSign and PO flow; share final signed SOW link when available.

Prep checklist (pre-kickoff)
- Customer to provide KMS ARN before production (not required for kickoff).
- Add Jae Kim (jae.kim@elevation.health) to technical invite.
- Make sure SOC2 attachments are in the Drive folder and our security contact has reviewed the customer's answers (attach Security_Questionnaire_Elevation.xlsx).

Risks/notes
- If procurement pushes SOW redlines to change deployment terms, alert execs immediately; there is zero tolerance for production outside US regions for this contract.
- We should schedule an internal dry-run for the technical kickoff (Marissa to host) on 2028-06-20 09:00 PT.

I'll get the draft plan started and loop in our PM to assign tickets. Vivek — ping me if you need additional capacity numbers or a call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
